items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: This being a production company that Marshall and myself own

ctx.x: But it could happen as well as anyone else. One thing that you all somewhat did together was, didn't you produce the Wild Chopper Tulas album?

The company here, parent company, produced it. I didn't go in with the Wild Chopper Tulas. This being a production company that Marshall and myself own, some of the things that we produce doesn't mean that I go in with it. I'm glad you're explaining that. When we produce LaBelle, I produce LaBelle. Every step of the way, every moment. Some other groups do their own thing enough, whereas I don't do my thing what I do musically with them, but I am still a part of the production company. We produce them. How do you…

So, that. So Marshall did the Wild Chopper Tulas album? You might say, yeah. Because that was just, to me, just a thing of beauty as it captures the street sound. Oh, yeah. Right. What made you decide to go record Motion in California? Jerry Wexton.
